senses.definition: (slang) The drug amphetamine, used recreationally for its stimulant effects.

quotes.text: Now from taking all this Benz and scrumpy and stuff, I wasn’t all that bright on remembering where I had been and what I was doing most of the time, and even when people spoke to me it took me about two minutes to register what they had said.
quotes.reference: 1961, Frank Norman, “A Parrot, a Juke-box and the Benz” (chapter 3), in Stand on Me: A true story of Soho with a glossary of slang, for those who need it, New York, N.Y.: Simon and Schuster, Inc., →LCCN, page 30:

senses.definition: (slang, UK) Clipping of benners (“a bag of cannabis worth £10”).
